scripts.dev:docker: HOST_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr $(route get default 2>/dev/null | grep interface | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}') docker compose up
scripts.dev:docker:build: HOST_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr $(route get default 2>/dev/null | grep interface | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}') docker compose up --build
